proposal.quote: Advices here are that Italy’s position is still that of non-cooperation of any League endeavor until Ethiopia be excluded.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Italy's continued refusal to cooperate with any League endeavor until Ethiopia is excluded, confirming estrangement from the West after Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: opinion in this country was definite against any active intervention in Spain other than by negotiation and that although in the French press there had appeared discussions of joint Anglo-French naval action the British Government had not considered such action
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The Foreign Office reports that British policy rejects active intervention in Spain other than negotiation and had not considered joint naval action, meeting the appease threshold of seeking settlement and no military commitment.

proposal.quote: the passing of the legislation making it impossible to prevent the repetition of such action
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports that legislation was enacted in the United States that forbids further shipments of war material, i.e. the mandatory arms-embargo regime of the Neutrality Acts, which meets the isolationist threshold.

proposal.quote: the close cooperation between Italy and Germany must be viewed in this light
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports as an existing state of affairs the close cooperation/alignment between Italy and Germany (with Italy having 'enter[ed] into close contact with the Germans'), which meets the Rome-Berlin alignment threshold; the protocol text is not named, so medium.

proposal.quote: In Italy more blame is attached to France for continuance of the war even than Soviet Russia and the Italian newspapers are bitterly critical of the French attitude.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Italian official and press hostility toward France, an estrangement from the West that satisfies the precondition for axis; the report is second-hand and partial, so low.

proposal.quote: Rome is favorable in principle to participation to become effective if and when Italy resumes cooperation with the League of Nations
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The report that Italian participation depends on Italy resuming cooperation with the League states that Italy is at present outside cooperation with the League, i.e. estranged from the Western powers assembled there, meeting the estrangement level.

proposal.quote: Blum said that he was in entire accord with Neurath’s opinion that an accord on Spain must be the gateway to larger agreements. He had instructed Poncet, therefore, to go slow for the moment.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Blum, the French Prime Minister, endorses Neurath's view that an accord on Spain is the gateway to larger agreements and directs Poncet to negotiate, which treats a negotiated general settlement as attainable and meets the limited threshold.

proposal.quote: Poncet would continue the conversations for the conclusion of a new Franco-German trade agreement and in the course of those conversations would explore the possibilities with regard to larger economic cooperation and limitation of armaments but would make no grand scale proposals until the situation in Spain had improved.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Blum directs Poncet to continue trade conversations and explore economic cooperation and armament limitation while making no grand proposals, a policy seeking a settlement that meets the appease threshold.

proposal.quote: an open willingness to treat Germany’s needs with the utmost generosity if and when the German Government indicates a disposition to enter into real cooperation with the states of Europe and make a thorough-going agreement which will guarantee the peace of Europe.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Wilson reports Eden's ministerial statement that Germany's needs can be met by a thorough-going general agreement if it cooperates, treating German aims as revision satisfiable by negotiated settlement.

proposal.quote: the Joint Resolution of January 8, 1937 makes unlawful the export of arms, ammunition and implements of war from the United States or its possessions to Spain
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports a mandatory arms embargo in force under the Joint Resolution, which supports the isolationist level as a Neutrality Act-style non-intervention regime, though its Spain-specific scope requires threshold judgment.

proposal.quote: upon the passage of the recent Resolution, authorizing the President to prohibit shipments of supplies to either of the contending military forces in his country
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports an arms-embargo resolution covering both contending forces in Spain and Hull states there was no recourse except to remain aloof, which matches the isolationist threshold of an embargo regime rather than engagement, though it does not explicitly call the embargo mandatory.

proposal.quote: the German-Japanese Anti-Communistic Pact ... shortly after the conclusion of the Anti-Communistic Pact
